title: Colorado Heat Action and Heat Emergency Respons Plan (Combined) 2025 - Colorado, United States of America
description: This action plan is relevant to all of Colorado, as heat waves are projected to increase rapidly statewide according to the Colorado Climate Preparedness Roadmap (see pages 19-21 for a summary of extreme heat impacts in Colorado). Heat Action Plans and toolkits are a way for health officials to partner across sectors to develop strategies and programs to help communities prepare for the health effects of climate change.
